![Irina, Carys, and lab alum Theresa Wilsterman at cSFN 2026](image.jpg){fig-alt="Irina, Carys, and lab alum Theresa Wilsterman at cSFN 2026" width="460"}

Congrats to SlugLab alum Carys McFaul, who has been awarded Dominican’s Mulroy Excellence Award, the highest honor for a graduating senior! Carys will speak at commencement on 5/9/2026… looking forward to it. (Yes, this is the same Carys McFaul who won 1st place at the cSFN meeting this spring… Carys is a superstar!)
